name: LA County Bloomberg Arts Internship (BAI) for rising high school seniors
org: LA County Department of Arts and Culture, with Bloomberg Philanthropies
what_you_do: Paid summer internship at an arts or culture group. You work 120 hours over 8 weeks. Monday to Wednesday you are at your worksite. On Thursdays and Fridays you join program days with other interns.
who_can_apply: Rising public high school seniors (entering senior year in fall 2027) who attend a public high school in LA County and live or go to school within 10 miles of the worksite. Must be able to work legally in the U.S. and bring a school ID and proof of work eligibility. No age rule is listed.
pay_detail: Paid. The hourly rate is not stated. Program Day participants also get a stipend for 90% participation, plus transportation help and lunch.
duration: 8 weeks, June 14 to August 6, 2027. Optional paid extension from September 2027 to April 2028 (22 weeks).
deadline_text: Student applications open in March 2027 when internship listings are posted. No student deadline is posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply for a listed internship when applications open in March 2027. Questions: BAI@arts.lacounty.gov.
notes: Schedule may change. You cannot be a current or former employee of the worksite or related to its staff. The 2026 internship positions list is on the Department's site. The page does not mention work permits. California requires a permit for paid work under 18.
